name: Orihara Sanae
source:
School: 2nd-year Moriyoh Gakuen
Description: she is a wonderful person
Profile: She's the type of girl that almost every guy likes - wonderful, kind, beautiful, smart, and she's not shabby at sports either. She plays tennis, and likes flowers. She believes that loving someone is more important than being loved.
